title: Unifying Ground and Air: A Comprehensive Review of Deep Learning-Enabled CAVs and UAVs
core_idea: Review and examine the integration of AI, particularly computer vision and deep learning, into connected autonomous vehicles (CAVs) and unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), focusing on AI-driven data fusion, communication and cooperation enabled by wireless technologies, the challenges of configuring DL models for safety-critical applications, and the security threats requiring timely threat analysis and countermeasures.
tldr: A concise review of how deep learning and AI-driven data fusion can enable cooperative perception and communication between CAVs and UAVs, and an assessment of the associated model-configuration challenges and cybersecurity risks that must be addressed.
